x:
Assaka (Asmaka) was one of the Sixteen Mahajanapadas mentioned in Buddhist literature. It was the only Mahajanapada located in the Deccan region. Its capital was Potali (Podana), which is identified with present-day Bodhan in Telangana. Assaka occupied an important position on the trade routes connecting North and South India. Later, this region came under the control of the Satavahanas.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).
